sources.title: Delta Group CSR Report 2010

sources.title: DELTA ELECTRONICS, INC. 2024 ANNUAL REPORT
sources.note: The report describes maintained leadership in power management and thermal solutions, but does not state that Delta ranks first in the global switching-power-supply market.

sources.title: Implementing sales platforms and facilitating cross-domain integration
sources.locator: Section “Building regional capabilities, integrating global operations”
sources.note: An interview with Delta's Executive Vice President of Global Business Operations says Delta gradually developed its own brand and describes operations across five continents.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches of official company materials and current ranking references did not resolve the present-tense global-largest claim with a defined market scope and denominator. It remains UNKNOWN; lack of resolving evidence is not treated as evidence that the ranking is false.
The “world's largest” wording appears as Delta's own historical claim; current official materials reviewed do not provide a comparative ranking, market-share measurement, or defined denominator.
Global brand-management activity supports global promotion but does not prove distribution or marketing in every country.
